test_bitwise_integral_schema: test the bitwise and_ and or_ operations preserve integral schema types on lazy frame selection
test_bit_counts: test bitwise_count_ones, bitwise_count_zeros, bitwise_leading_ones, bitwise_leading_zeros, bitwise_trailing_ones, and bitwise_trailing_zeros across integer and boolean dtypes
test_bit_aggregations: test bitwise_and, bitwise_or, and bitwise_xor aggregations on integer series with and without null values
test_bit_group_by: test bitwise_and, bitwise_or, and bitwise_xor aggregations grouped by a key column in a polars dataframe
test_bool_bitwise_with_nulls: test bitwise_and, bitwise_or, and bitwise_xor on boolean columns with null values across multiple columns
